_meta.note: Role → required-skill weights (0..1, importance of the skill for the role). Weights within a role sum to ~1.0. Skill ids reference skills.json. time_to_ready_base_months assumes ~6-8 hrs/week of study for someone starting from a clerical baseline.
_meta.source: Curated from O*NET/ESCO role descriptors and India job-posting skill frequencies (curated snapshot).

roles.name: Data Entry Operator
roles.description: Current clerical baseline role — high automation exposure.

roles.name: Data Quality Analyst
roles.description: Owns the accuracy, completeness and consistency of an organisation's data — the natural, low-jump upgrade from data entry because attention-to-detail transfers directly.

roles.name: Business Intelligence Associate
roles.description: Turns raw business data into dashboards and reports leaders act on.

roles.name: Operations Automation Specialist
roles.description: Automates the very repetitive clerical workflows this worker already understands — turning displacement risk into displacement expertise.

roles.name: Data Analyst
roles.description: Answers business questions with data — the flagship data-adjacent role.

roles.name: Reporting Analyst
roles.description: Builds recurring MIS/operational reports — closest to existing spreadsheet work.

roles.name: CRM Data Coordinator
roles.description: Maintains and analyses customer data inside CRM systems — leans on customer-service and data-hygiene skills.

roles.name: Junior Data Engineer
roles.description: Builds the pipelines that move and shape data — highest payoff, steepest climb.
